operators.name: fused_relu_cos_scale
semantics: Applies ReLU activation elementwise (max(0, x)) to input tensor x on CUDA device.
Then computes elementwise cos of the ReLU result.
Adds scalar scale multiplied by 0.1 to each element, i.e., output = cos(relu(x)) + 0.1 * scale.
The scale parameter is a Python float passed to the extension, representing out_features from the model.
Input and output tensors are torch.float32 on CUDA, shape same as reference step.
No in-place modification of input; output is a new tensor allocated with contiguous memory.
Applies ReLU activation in-place to input tensor x (shape [16,64,512,512], float32, CUDA).
Result x has same shape, dtype, device; values are max(0, original x).
Computes elementwise cosine of current x (post-ReLU).
Adds scalar 0.1 * self.out_features (102.4) to each element.
Returns the final tensor from step_002.
